# Features

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:features` from the ribbon tables (src/core/help/ribbonTabs.js)
     and the guide (src/guide/). Do not edit by hand: a unit test fails when it is stale. -->

Every command in WebSfM's ribbon: where to find it, what it does, and the guide article
that explains it (the same text the app shows under **Other ▸ Guide**). The tabs
**Picture**, **DEM / Orthophoto** and **Reference raster** appear when an image, a
product or an imported raster is open in front.

## View

| Where | Command | What it does | Guide |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| View ▸ Inspect | Images | Each photo's EXIF, camera and pose, as read and as estimated. |  |
| View ▸ Inspect | Masks | Each photo's mask; import masks one by one or a folder at once. |  |
| View ▸ Inspect | Sensors | The cameras and their calibration; split a group that holds several cameras. | [Camera Groups](../src/guide/camera-groups.md) |
| View ▸ Inspect | Camera Poses | Each photo's camera position and orientation, imported or estimated. |  |
| View ▸ Inspect | Control & Markers | GCPs, checkpoints and markers: their coordinates, marks and residuals. |  |
| View ▸ Inspect | Matches | Every image pair and its matches; leave a pair out of the reconstruction. |  |
| View ▸ Camera | Top, Bottom, Left, Right, Front, Back, Reset View, Turntable | Move around the model, frame it with the view presets, and let it turn on its own — or record one turn as a video. | [The 3D View](../src/guide/3d-view.md) |
| View ▸ Scene | Cameras, Grid, Legend, Points |  | [The 3D View](../src/guide/3d-view.md) |
| View ▸ Map | Fit View, Layers, Grid, Cameras, GCPs, Model Frame |  |  |
| View ▸ Map | Footprints | Outline the ground each image covers from its camera pose, before any matching, for match preselection and a first look at coverage. | [Footprints from Poses](../src/guide/footprints-from-poses.md) |
| View ▸ Map | Photos | Lay the photos themselves on the 2D map, placed by their aligned cameras or by their footprints, to check coverage and fit at a glance. | [Photos on the Map](../src/guide/map-photos.md) |
| View ▸ Map ▸ Basemap | Automatic | Street map, or the matching NASA layer for polar CRSs. |  |
| View ▸ Map ▸ Basemap | Streets | OpenStreetMap. |  |
| View ▸ Map ▸ Basemap | Satellite | Esri World Imagery, or your own source (Settings). |  |
| View ▸ Map ▸ Basemap | Terrain | Shaded relief of a global elevation model. |  |
| View ▸ Map ▸ Basemap | None | Grid only. |  |

## Import

| Where | Command | What it does | Guide |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Import ▸ Images | Images | Add photos to the project. | [Getting Started](../src/guide/getting-started.md) |
| Import ▸ Images | Video | Turn a video into sharp, overlapping frames that reconstruct like photos. | [Import Video](../src/guide/video-import.md) |
| Import ▸ Images | Image Fiducials | Fiducial marks measured on each film scan, from a CSV or text file. | [Film Scans & Fiducials](../src/guide/film-fiducials.md) |
| Import ▸ Cameras | Camera Poses | Camera positions and orientations (GNSS, RTK or another tool) from a CSV or text file. | [Export Camera Poses](../src/guide/export-camera-poses.md) |
| Import ▸ Cameras | Calibration | Camera calibration from a CSV or text file, as Export ▸ Calibration writes it. | [Export Calibration](../src/guide/export-calibration.md) |
| Import ▸ Cameras | Camera Fiducials | A film camera's calibrated fiducial positions, from its calibration certificate. | [Film Scans & Fiducials](../src/guide/film-fiducials.md) |
| Import ▸ Ground Control | GCP File | Ground control points and their coordinates, from a CSV or text file. Aerial projects only. | [Georeferencing & Scale](../src/guide/georeferencing.md) |
| Import ▸ Reference Data | Reference DEM / Ortho | A DEM or orthophoto to compare with, find GCPs in, or co-register to. | [Co-register DEM](../src/guide/coregister-dem.md) |
| Import ▸ Reference Data | Point Cloud / Mesh | A point cloud or mesh from another tool, to edit, mesh, compare or align with. | [Distance to Reference](../src/guide/cloud-distance.md) |
| Import ▸ Interoperability | WebSfM Project | Another WebSfM project's photos, features and matches, into this one. | [Import Project](../src/guide/import-project.md) |
| Import ▸ Interoperability | COLMAP | A COLMAP database, sparse model or workspace: cameras, keypoints, matches, the sparse model. | [Import from COLMAP and other SfM tools](../src/guide/import-sfm.md) |
| Import ▸ Interoperability | Metashape | Metashape cameras or markers XML: calibration, camera poses, markers and scale bars. | [Import from Metashape](../src/guide/import-metashape.md) |
| Import ▸ Interoperability | Other SfM | Bundler, VisualSFM NVM, OpenMVG, OpenSfM or transforms.json: cameras and the sparse model. | [Import from COLMAP and other SfM tools](../src/guide/import-sfm.md) |
| Import ▸ Interoperability | Keypoints & Matches | Keypoints and matches from text or CSV files, such as another detector or matcher writes. | [Import Keypoints & Matches](../src/guide/import-features.md) |

## Reconstruct

| Where | Command | What it does | Guide |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Reconstruct ▸ Workflow | Workflow Builder | Run several stages in one go, with quality checks between them. | [Workflow Builder](../src/guide/workflow-builder.md) |
| Reconstruct ▸ Features | Detect Features | Find keypoints in every photo, with SIFT or a learned detector. | [Detect Features](../src/guide/detect-features.md) |
| Reconstruct ▸ Features | Match Features | Match keypoints between image pairs and verify each pair geometrically. | [Match Features](../src/guide/match-features.md) |
| Reconstruct ▸ Sparse | Sparse Model | Solve the camera poses and calibration, and triangulate the tie points. | [Sparse Reconstruction](../src/guide/sparse-reconstruction.md) |
| Reconstruct ▸ Georeferencing | Edit GCPs | Mark GCPs on the image in front, or place them on the map. | [Georeferencing & Scale](../src/guide/georeferencing.md) |
| Reconstruct ▸ Georeferencing | Find GCPs | Find GCPs automatically by matching the photos to a reference orthophoto. Aerial projects only. | [Georeferencing & Scale](../src/guide/georeferencing.md) |
| Reconstruct ▸ Georeferencing | Georeference | Place the model in a coordinate system, from GCPs or camera positions. Aerial projects only. | [Georeferencing & Scale](../src/guide/georeferencing.md) |
| Reconstruct ▸ Georeferencing | Scale Bars | Scale the model from known distances between points in the photos. | [Georeferencing & Scale](../src/guide/georeferencing.md) |
| Reconstruct ▸ Dense | Depth Maps | Estimate a depth map for each photo from its neighbours (PatchMatch). | [Build Depth Maps](../src/guide/depth-maps.md) |
| Reconstruct ▸ Dense | Dense Model | Fuse the depth maps into a dense, coloured point cloud. | [Build Dense Cloud](../src/guide/dense-cloud.md) |
| Reconstruct ▸ Products | DEM | Grid a point cloud into an elevation model: surface (DSM) or bare earth (DTM). Aerial projects only. | [Build DEM](../src/guide/dem.md) |
| Reconstruct ▸ Products | Ortho | Project the photos onto a DEM or mesh into one orthophoto. Aerial projects only. | [Build Orthophoto](../src/guide/orthophoto.md) |
| Reconstruct ▸ Products | Reflectance | Calibrated reflectance maps from a multispectral camera's bands. Aerial projects only. | [Reflectance Map](../src/guide/reflectance-map.md) |
| Reconstruct ▸ Products | Mesh | Build a surface mesh from the dense cloud (screened Poisson). | [Build Mesh](../src/guide/mesh.md) |

## Tools

| Where | Command | What it does | Guide |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tools ▸ Images | Image quality… | Score sharpness and exposure; exclude blurry images. | [Image Quality, Region and Orientation](../src/guide/model-tools.md) |
| Tools ▸ Images | Detect targets… | Mark GCP targets: checker mats where the model expects them, or AprilTags. | [Detect Targets](../src/guide/detect-targets.md) |
| Tools ▸ Images | Reduce overlap… | Disable the photos a dense block does not need for depth maps. | [Reduce Overlap](../src/guide/reduce-overlap.md) |
| Tools ▸ Images | Auto mask… | Mask the edges (a fixed strip or the film frame), the text on the photos, or both. | [Masks](../src/guide/masks.md) |
| Tools ▸ Images | Read text… | Read the text on the photos: frame numbers, data strips, the focal length printed on them. | [Masks](../src/guide/masks.md) |
| Tools ▸ Images | Detect fiducials… | Find the fiducial marks on scanned film frames. | [Film Scans & Fiducials](../src/guide/film-fiducials.md) |
| Tools ▸ Images | Calibrate fiducials… | Camera-certificate or batch-estimated fiducial layout. | [Film Scans & Fiducials](../src/guide/film-fiducials.md) |
| Tools ▸ Images | Detect reseau… | Measure the reseau crosses: scan placement and film deformation per scan. | [Detect Reseau](../src/guide/reseau.md) |
| Tools ▸ Images | Split panoramic strips… | Cut panoramic (optical-bar) scans into frame-camera segments. | [Split Panoramic Strips](../src/guide/panoramic.md) |
| Tools ▸ Model | Optimize cameras… | Re-run bundle adjustment with chosen lens parameters. | [Optimize Cameras](../src/guide/optimize-cameras.md) |
| Tools ▸ Model | Gradual selection… | Remove weak tie points by error, views or angle. | [Sparse Reconstruction](../src/guide/sparse-reconstruction.md) |
| Tools ▸ Model | Region… | A box that limits depth maps, fusion, mesh and DEM. | [Image Quality, Region and Orientation](../src/guide/model-tools.md) |
| Tools ▸ Model | Orient model… | Level the model and set its origin (projects without CRS). | [Image Quality, Region and Orientation](../src/guide/model-tools.md) |
| Tools ▸ Model | Footprints from poses… | Project image outlines onto the ground. Aerial projects only. | [Footprints from Poses](../src/guide/footprints-from-poses.md) |
| Tools ▸ Point Cloud | Filter… | Height/brightness range, voxel, isolated points, outliers. | [Filter Cloud](../src/guide/filter-cloud.md) |
| Tools ▸ Point Cloud | Remove outliers… | Statistical outlier removal. | [Filter Cloud](../src/guide/filter-cloud.md) |
| Tools ▸ Point Cloud | Subsample… | Thin to one point per voxel. | [Filter Cloud](../src/guide/filter-cloud.md) |
| Tools ▸ Point Cloud | Select (rectangle) | Drag a box in the 3D view, then delete or keep. | [Point Cloud Tools](../src/guide/point-cloud-tools.md) |
| Tools ▸ Point Cloud | Select (lasso) | Draw a freehand outline in the 3D view, then delete or keep. | [Point Cloud Tools](../src/guide/point-cloud-tools.md) |
| Tools ▸ Point Cloud | Crop… | Keep or remove an axis-aligned box. | [Crop Cloud or Mesh](../src/guide/crop-cloud.md) |
| Tools ▸ Point Cloud | Transform… | Move, rotate, scale, or apply a 4×4 matrix. | [Transform Cloud](../src/guide/transform-cloud.md) |
| Tools ▸ Point Cloud | Merge… | Concatenate clouds with an optional seam dedupe. | [Merge Clouds](../src/guide/merge-clouds.md) |
| Tools ▸ Point Cloud | Align by point pairs… | Pick ≥3 matching points in both clouds. | [Transform Cloud](../src/guide/transform-cloud.md) |
| Tools ▸ Point Cloud | Align to reference (ICP)… | Refine an approximate alignment automatically. | [Align to Reference (ICP)](../src/guide/align-icp.md) |
| Tools ▸ Point Cloud | Estimate normals… | Per-point normals, e.g. to mesh an imported cloud. | [Estimate Normals](../src/guide/estimate-normals.md) |
| Tools ▸ Point Cloud | Classify points… | Ground for a DTM, then buildings and vegetation. | [Classify Points](../src/guide/classify-ground.md) |
| Tools ▸ Mesh | Clean mesh… | Small pieces, long-edge bridges, holes (watertight). | [Clean Mesh](../src/guide/clean-mesh.md) |
| Tools ▸ Mesh | Smooth… | Taubin smoothing without shrinkage. | [Smooth Mesh](../src/guide/smooth-mesh.md) |
| Tools ▸ Mesh | Decimate… | Reduce to a target triangle count (quadric collapse). | [Decimate Mesh](../src/guide/decimate-mesh.md) |
| Tools ▸ Mesh | Crop… | Keep or remove an axis-aligned box. | [Crop Cloud or Mesh](../src/guide/crop-cloud.md) |
| Tools ▸ Mesh | Sample to points… | Uniform surface sampling into a dense cloud. | [Sample Mesh to Points](../src/guide/sample-mesh.md) |
| Tools ▸ Mesh | Texture… | Photo texture from the registered cameras. | [Texture Mesh](../src/guide/texture-mesh.md) |
| Tools ▸ Products | Contours… | Contour lines from the DEM (GeoJSON / DXF). Aerial projects only. | [Contour Lines](../src/guide/contours.md) |
| Tools ▸ Products | Slope, aspect, hillshade… | Terrain derivative rasters as GeoTIFF. Aerial projects only. | [Slope, Aspect, Hillshade](../src/guide/terrain-derivatives.md) |
| Tools ▸ Products | Co-register DEM… | Shift and tilt the DEM, or the georeference, onto a reference DEM. Aerial projects only. | [Co-register DEM](../src/guide/coregister-dem.md) |
| Tools ▸ Products | Clip to polygon… | Export a DEM/ortho clipped to a polygon. Aerial projects only. | [Clip to Polygon](../src/guide/clip-raster.md) |
| Tools ▸ Measure | Ruler | Ground distance along a polyline. | [Build DEM](../src/guide/dem.md) |
| Tools ▸ Measure | Area | Planimetric area and perimeter of a polygon. | [Build DEM](../src/guide/dem.md) |
| Tools ▸ Measure | Profile | Elevation profile along a line (DEM). | [Build DEM](../src/guide/dem.md) |
| Tools ▸ Measure | Volume | Cut / fill against a base surface (DEM). | [Build DEM](../src/guide/dem.md) |
| Tools ▸ Measure | Saved measurements | Show, reopen and export saved results. | [Build DEM](../src/guide/dem.md) |
| Tools ▸ Measure | Measure in 3D | Distance, height and surface area picked on clouds and meshes. | [Point Cloud Tools](../src/guide/point-cloud-tools.md) |
| Tools ▸ Measure | Distance to reference… | Per-point distance to another cloud or a mesh (change detection). | [Distance to Reference](../src/guide/cloud-distance.md) |
| Tools ▸ Measure | Section… | Cut a thin slice and export it as a 2D profile. | [Point Cloud Tools](../src/guide/point-cloud-tools.md) |
| Tools ▸ Measure | Mesh area & volume… | Surface area; enclosed volume when watertight. | [Build Mesh](../src/guide/mesh.md) |
| Tools ▸ Measure | DEM of difference | Gain and loss inside a polygon against a reference DEM or the background terrain. | [Build DEM](../src/guide/dem.md) |

## Evaluate

| Where | Command | What it does | Guide |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Evaluate ▸ Report | Quality Report | How each stage went, and what to fix first. | [Quality Report](../src/guide/quality-report.md) |
| Evaluate ▸ Features | Matching | The match graph: weak links, disconnected groups, photos with few matches. | [Quality Report](../src/guide/quality-report.md) |
| Evaluate ▸ Sparse | Sparse Model | Registration, track lengths and reprojection errors of the sparse model. | [Quality Report](../src/guide/quality-report.md) |
| Evaluate ▸ Sparse | Calibration | The estimated lens: focal length, principal point, distortion. | [Quality Report](../src/guide/quality-report.md) |
| Evaluate ▸ Sparse | Accuracy | Residuals at checkpoints and camera positions against their reference coordinates. | [Quality Report](../src/guide/quality-report.md) |
| Evaluate ▸ Sparse | Coverage | Where tie points cluster or are missing, on a coverage map. | [Quality Report](../src/guide/quality-report.md) |
| Evaluate ▸ Dense | Depth Coverage | How much of each photo its depth map covers. | [Quality Report](../src/guide/quality-report.md) |
| Evaluate ▸ Products | DEM vs Reference | The DEM against a reference DEM: the differences and their statistics. Aerial projects only. | [Quality Report](../src/guide/quality-report.md) |

## Export

| Where | Command | What it does | Guide |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Export ▸ Cameras | Camera Poses | Camera positions and orientations as CSV, text or GeoJSON. | [Export Camera Poses](../src/guide/export-camera-poses.md) |
| Export ▸ Cameras | Calibration | Camera calibration as CSV or text. | [Export Calibration](../src/guide/export-calibration.md) |
| Export ▸ Cameras | Camera Fiducials | The film cameras' fiducial positions as CSV or text. | [Film Scans & Fiducials](../src/guide/film-fiducials.md) |
| Export ▸ Cameras | Footprints | The ground each photo covers, as GeoJSON or KML. | [Footprints from Poses](../src/guide/footprints-from-poses.md) |
| Export ▸ Features | Image Fiducials | The fiducial marks measured on each scan, as CSV or text. | [Film Scans & Fiducials](../src/guide/film-fiducials.md) |
| Export ▸ Features | Key points | Every photo's keypoints as JSON or CSV. |  |
| Export ▸ Features | Matches | The verified matches of every pair as JSON or CSV. |  |
| Export ▸ Reconstruction | Model JSON | Cameras and tracks as JSON, or transforms.json for NeRF and Gaussian splatting. |  |
| Export ▸ Geometry | Point Cloud | A point cloud as PLY, LAS, LAZ, COPC or XYZ. | [Point Cloud Tools](../src/guide/point-cloud-tools.md) |
| Export ▸ Geometry | Mesh | A mesh as PLY, glTF, OBJ or STL. | [Texture Mesh](../src/guide/texture-mesh.md) |
| Export ▸ Products | DEM | A DEM as GeoTIFF, Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF, ESRI ASCII grid or hillshade PNG. Aerial projects only. | [Build DEM](../src/guide/dem.md) |
| Export ▸ Products | Ortho | An orthophoto as GeoTIFF, Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF, PNG or JPEG, MBTiles or XYZ tiles. Aerial projects only. | [Build Orthophoto](../src/guide/orthophoto.md) |
| Export ▸ Products | Measurements | Saved measurements as CSV or GeoJSON. | [Build DEM](../src/guide/dem.md) |
| Export ▸ Interoperability | SfM Project | The cameras, features and sparse model for COLMAP, OpenMVG, VisualSFM, Metashape or NeRF tools. | [Import from COLMAP and other SfM tools](../src/guide/import-sfm.md) |
| Export ▸ Interoperability | Undistorted Images | The photos with the lens distortion removed, as JPEG or PNG. |  |
| Export ▸ Interoperability | 3D Tiles | A point cloud or mesh as Cesium 3D Tiles. | [Export 3D Tiles](../src/guide/export-3d-tiles.md) |
